newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SMP 1997 SEES STRONG SECOND HALF YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SMP 1997 SEES STRONG SECOND HALF YEAR.

text.p: Superior Metal Printing Ltd (SMP) said on Wednesday it expected full year results to be boosted in the second half of the year.
It reported earnings of Singapore $770,000 for the six months to June 30, 1997, up 25.5 percent.
"The board of directors expects the attributable net pre-tax profit for the second half from the existing operations to be better than the first half," SMP said in a statement.
"The outlook of core business of metal pails, cans and flexible pacakging continues to be positive," the firm added in a statement accompanying its first half results.
